name: Inc42

sources.title: Inc42 'Get Your Startup Discovered' — 'Submit Your Startup' CTA on a BrandLabs-branded page selling exposure (25M+ monthly reach claims); sibling links: Startup Spotlight, Guest Posts, Advertise; 'Startup Booster Packages' marketed on the same page

conditions: The 'Submit Your Startup' page is part of Inc42's BrandLabs commercial offering — featured-startup coverage is sold as 'Startup Spotlight'/'Startup Booster Packages'; earned editorial exists separately but there is no free guaranteed listing
requirements: Indian startup ecosystem focus — Inc42 covers India's tech/startup economy
Paid route: Submit Your Startup / Startup Spotlight / Startup Booster Packages via BrandLabs
Earned route: editorial coverage of funding/news in the Indian ecosystem; guest-post route exists as a labeled nav item
Inc42 Plus is a paid reader subscription — unrelated to submissions
preparation: India relevance — the readership is the Indian startup ecosystem
For paid features: budget for a BrandLabs package (pricing not public on the page)
For earned coverage: a funding round, launch, or trend story with India significance
workflow: Open inc42.com/startup-submission and use 'Submit Your Startup' — expect this to route into the paid BrandLabs flow
For earned coverage, pitch the newsroom via Contact Us with an India-ecosystem story
Guest Posts and Advertise are separate nav items under 'Partner with Inc42'
watchFor: The submission page reads as marketing for paid packages — do not assume free coverage
India-only relevance — a SaaS with no India angle won't fit either route
'Recently Featured Startups' mix editorial and BrandLabs content — check the label
Inc42 runs paid courses/events — the site has many commercial surfaces
countsAsLive: The startup is featured in an Inc42 article (earned or labeled BrandLabs feature)
unknowns: Startup Booster/Spotlight pricing — not published on the page
Whether the Submit form itself is free or paywalled at the end
